findings.patrol: Source clears all waypoints, writes SAFE/LIMITED/YELLOW/random formation and forced gunlights; creates MOVE waypoints and loops back via statement. Dynamic statement rewrites non-current group waypoints; optional area rejection loops have no iteration bound. Optional teleport uses setVehiclePosition. Useful task intent: bounded route pattern in selected area, revisiting/changing points and optional reinforcement. CBE currently has no patrol task executor/module; CortexGroupMove owns only one temporary waypoint and does not implement patrol. Garrison/defence do not substitute.
findings.hunt: Source scheduled wait loop repeatedly findsClosestTarget, group move with distance-scaled uncertainty, speed/lights/lasers and optional flares (including created fallback). findClosestTarget scans allUnits or playable/switchable units and reads exact transforms without native knowledge. Useful deliberate search/pursuit intent must use native/contact belief and existing search/knowledge owner. CBE autonomous SEARCH is related but is not a selectable Hunt task.
findings.rush: Source indefinitely seeks helper-selected targets, disables FSM/AUTOCOMBAT, suppresses fleeing, adds per-actor Fired/Suppressed handlers and repeatedly doMoves exact target positions; source handles nearby armour/air differently. Useful aggressive task intent can use existing assault/advance/combined arms, but CBE has no explicit Rush task. Do not replace the standalone CBE danger FSM, flatten ROE or start a parallel target/movement loop.
findings.reset: Source blanket-enables AI features, resets speed/stance/animation, follows leader, clears variables/optional waypoints and by default creates a replacement group. Soft reset retains the group, so taskHunt/Rush loops whose only terminal condition is group death may remain. CBE must preserve mission flags/group/order ownership and exact feature journals; raw reset is rejected, not parity completion.
findings.moduleIntent: Patrol native module exposes task radius/count/dynamic pattern/reinforcement/teleport parameters. ZEN context dispatch and waypoint wrapper call the actual task; these are behaviour controls, not CBA setting modules. Native CBE registration currently exposes convoy, garrison, defence, corridor and airborne; optional ZEN also clear. Existing authenticated RELEASE executor was inaccessible as a dedicated native/ZEN behaviour module.

implemented.path: Explicit squad selection or attached AI soldier -> existing CortexOrderDispatch -> authenticated serial/deadline/native/Zeus receipt checks -> CortexOrderLocal RELEASE -> existing Clear/Garrison/Defend and temporary infantry actor cleanup.
implemented.policies: No addon setting changes, nearest squad guess, replacement group, blanket AI/animation reset, waypoint clearing, forced seating/teleport, new worker or RPC. Native module works without ZEN; optional ZEN dialog has a labelled bounded squad selector. Duplicate/late/changed-owner requests retain the existing refusal. Release refusal now has a task-specific explanation.
implemented.scope: Existing supported infantry task release only; no convoy/flight/artillery/drill stop-all promise. Accepted request is not proven physical formation recovery, and native handback may remain unresolved.

nextRequired: Implement patrol executor first in the existing common operation/group movement lifecycle: bounded area planning, explicit task area/pattern, original participant/order/settings capture, original leg/task budget, current-owner continuation and exact own-waypoint cleanup; preserve authored/Zeus route and active danger responsiveness. Expose behaviour controls only after executor exists. Then knowledge-based Hunt and explicit aggressive task, using existing search/drill/fire owners rather than source omniscience/FSM disable. Teleport outside explicit garrison exception is not authorised by this review.
